headline: As of 2026-11-23: 74,406,187 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+4.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 74,406,187 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+4.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (11,308,974), Texas (8,129,145), Florida (8,082,610).
